The plate is a square dinner plate, about 26 cm across, which makes the pizza piece roughly 4 cm by 8 cm. That is a thin flatbread slice with cheese, onion, and some meat or mushroom on top. I estimate it at about 45 g and 130 kcal.

There are 7 kalamata olives, each around 4 g, so about 28 g in total. At roughly 1.5 kcal per gram, that comes to about 40 kcal.

Together that is about 73 g of food and about 170 kcal.
